description: Computes an invoice due date from an issue date and net terms in calendar days (Net 30 = 30), then optionally rolls a weekend or U.S. holiday due date: following (next business day), preceding, or modified_following (next business day unless it crosses into the next month). Uses exact observed federal or Federal Reserve holidays.

calendar.description: fed_banking (default) matches when banks settle payments; federal uses OPM observance.

extra_closed_dates.description: Extra closed dates to treat as holidays, e.g. a one-off executive order closure such as 2025-01-09.

net_days.description: Net terms in calendar days, e.g. 30 for Net 30.

roll.description: How to move a due date that is not a business day.

name: invoice_due_date
title: Invoice due date from net terms
